answer: A concrete sybil defense is an attestation trellis: an agent's economic weight grows only when several independent, already-established peers countersign its transactions. Each sockpuppet must earn real vouching separately, so mass-forging identities becomes expensive instead of free. A fresh identity with zero countersignatures hangs at the ledger's edge like a violet shadow — visible but weightless — while the onyx-black record of who attested whom makes fake clusters trivially easy to spot and prune.
